title: ticfac enforces the repo's PR+CI close-out rule nowhere: each closeout attempt re-derives the missing PR by hand
body: This repository's rule (.tick/config.md) is that an epic close-out may not complete until the CI workflow is green on the epic's PR. ticfac pushed the epic branch but never opened the PR, and the checkpoint carries no PR-or-CI state, so closeout attempts 11 and 12 each had to rediscover the same unmet precondition by reading the repo's config. Even if opening the PR after the retro is deliberate sequencing, the rule's satisfaction is invisible to the run state: ticfac should treat PR existence + green CI as an admission precondition of the closeout phase, or at least track it in the checkpoint, instead of leaving a hard rule to model diligence.
